  - main:
    - text: CLASS 12 · MATRICES AND DETERMINANTS
    - heading "Inverse by Adjoint" [level=1]
    - text: Compute the inverse of a matrix using the adjoint method and verify the result. 22 min ADVANCED CONCEPT matrix inverse
    - link "← School lessons":
      - /url: /lessons/school
    - button "Reset lab":
      - img
      - text: Reset lab
    - button "New example":
      - img
      - text: New example
    - heading "THE FOUR-STAGE INVERSE MACHINE" [level=2]
    - button "Stage 1 Input & Determinant Enter matrix and compute det(A)"
    - button "Stage 2 Adjoint Compute adj(A)"
    - button "Stage 3 Inverse A⁻¹ = adj(A) / det(A)"
    - button "Stage 4 Verify Check A·A⁻¹ and A⁻¹·A"
    - heading "1 INPUT & DETERMINANT" [level=2]
    - article:
      - text: Matrix A
      - emphasis: A =
      - text: 1 2 3 0 4 5 1 0 6
    - article:
      - text: det(A)
      - strong: "22"
    - text: det(A) ≠ 0 — Inverse exists.
    - complementary:
      - text: DETERMINANT GATE
      - paragraph: If det(A)=0, the inverse does not exist.
      - button "Inverse disabled when det(A)=0" [disabled]
    - heading "2 ADJOINT OF A" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Adjoint is the transpose of the cofactor matrix.
    - emphasis: adj(A)
    - text: 24 -12 -2 5 3 -5 -4 2 4
    - button "Show cofactor matrix":
      - img
      - text: Show cofactor matrix
    - heading "3 INVERSE OF A" [level=2]
    - text: A⁻¹ = 1 / det(A) · adj(A) = 1/22 · adj(A)
    - emphasis: A⁻¹ = 1/22
    - text: 24 -12 -2 5 3 -5 -4 2 4
    - emphasis: =
    - text: 12/11 -6/11 -1/11 5/22 3/22 -5/22 -2/11 1/11 2/11
    - heading "4 VERIFY" [level=2]
    - article:
      - text: "Check 1: A · A⁻¹ = I₃"
      - img
      - text: Verified 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1
      - emphasis: = I₃
    - article:
      - text: "Check 2: A⁻¹ · A = I₃"
      - img
      - text: Verified 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1
      - emphasis: = I₃
    - heading "INSPECT A MULTIPLICATION CELL (Row · Column)" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Explore how entries of the product are computed.
    - text: Inspect
    - combobox "Inspect":
      - option "A · A⁻¹" [selected]
      - option "A⁻¹ · A"
    - text: Cell (i,j)
    - combobox "Cell (i,j)":
      - option "(1, 1)"
      - option "(1, 2)" [selected]
      - option "(1, 3)"
      - option "(2, 1)"
      - option "(2, 2)"
      - option "(2, 3)"
      - option "(3, 1)"
      - option "(3, 2)"
      - option "(3, 3)"
    - article: Row 1 [ 1 2 3 ] Column 2 -6/11 3/22 1/11
    - article:
      - text: Dot product
      - paragraph: 1 · -6/11
      - paragraph: 2 · 3/22
      - paragraph: 3 · 1/11
      - strong: = 0
    - article:
      - paragraph:
        - text: So, (A·A⁻¹)
        - subscript: 1,2
        - text: = 0
      - text: 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 This cell equals 0.
    - complementary:
      - heading "DO NOT USE ELEMENTWISE RECIPROCALS" [level=2]
      - text: ELEMENTWISE RECIPROCALS
      - paragraph: Taking reciprocals of entries is NOT the inverse.
      - text: 1 2 3 0 4 5 1 0 6
      - paragraph: This is not the inverse. Always use the adjoint method.
      - heading "SINGULAR-MATRIX COMPARISON" [level=2]
      - paragraph: "Example: S ="
      - text: 1 2 3 2 4 6 1 2 3
      - strong: det(S) = 0
      - paragraph: S is singular. Inverse does not exist.
      - text: 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0
      - heading "QUICK MEMORY" [level=2]
      - paragraph: ① If det(A) ≠ 0, A⁻¹ exists.
      - paragraph: ② A⁻¹ = adj(A)/det(A).
      - paragraph: ③ Verify with both products.
    - 'heading "PRACTICE: 2 × 2 INVERSE (BY ADJOINT)" [level=2]'
    - article:
      - text: Matrix B
      - emphasis: B =
      - text: 4 7 2 6
    - article:
      - text: Solution
      - paragraph: det(B) = 10
      - paragraph: adj(B) =
      - text: 6 -7 -2 4
      - paragraph: B⁻¹ = 1/10 adj(B)
      - text: 3/5 -7/10 -1/5 2/5
    - article:
      - text: Verify 1 0 0 1
      - img
      - text: Verified
    - article:
      - text: Try one
      - emphasis: C =
      - text: 2 -1 5 3
      - paragraph: Compute C⁻¹.
      - button "Show answer"
    - text: "Key takeaway: For any non-singular matrix A, the inverse is A⁻¹ = adj(A)/det(A)."
    - group: Additional examples and concept checks
